How Angadi Works

From the shepherd's morning walk to your kitchen — every step is designed for freshness, hygiene and trust.

🏘️ 01
Village Sourcing
Our team visits 200+ partner villages across Telangana to handpick free-range livestock directly from farmers
🩺 02
Vet Inspection
Licensed veterinarian certifies every animal for health, age and quality before it enters our facility
🏭 03
Hygienic Processing
FSSAI-certified facility with zero cross-contamination protocols. Halal certified slaughter
🧪 04
Lab Test & Pack
Every batch lab-tested, vacuum-sealed and chilled immediately to lock in freshness and safety
🚚 05
Doorstep Delivery
Refrigerated vehicles deliver to your Hyderabad address within 48 hours of processing

Our Story

Born in the
heart of Telangana

In the dusty lanes of rural Telangana, livestock has always been part of life — grazed freely, fed naturally, raised with care passed through generations. Angadi was born to bring this authentic wholesome produce to your urban kitchen.

We work directly with village shepherd families across Nalgonda, Rangareddy, Mahbubnagar and Adilabad. No middlemen. No factory farms. Just the real thing — processed fresh and delivered within 48 hours.
